entry: app/layout.tsx -> app/globals.css -> q-design.foundation.css + q-design.theme.css; runtime metadata -> lib/design/q-design-palette.ts
scope: Authored screen/paper CSS and the complete pinned Tailwind primitive preset are central. Product globals contains imports only. 329 numeric utility occurrences in 58 files are connected to shared roles or 78 central defaults; the exact map is carnet-utility-values.json. Only actual data, measured viewport geometry, encoded artwork and documented paper constraints remain runtime boundaries.

runtimeBoundaries.reason: Company identity and uploaded artwork are runtime data. Palette defaults, native title bar and contrast backgrounds are generated by Q-Design. Explicit company colors override named --qd-company-brand* variables. #b8935a remains the immutable historical database sentinel. Color mixing coefficients and pure black/white contrast endpoints are the algorithm contract, parity-tested against canonical generation.
User-selected color swatches preview submitted values. They cannot be replaced by the default palette. Image object-fit is central through data-logo-fit.
Only measured left/top coordinates are inline. Width, height limit, inset and anchor gap come from central CSS; the positioning helper measures the rendered panel before clamping it.
ResizeObserver writes the actual banner height to --qd-rail-offset. A static token cannot replace measured wrapped text height.
The optional column width prop describes record composition. Font, cell padding, alignment, color, borders and row interaction remain canonical table CSS.

Progress width is computed from completed/total or route progress. Visibility is interaction state. Progress appearance and transitions are canonical; copied top-progress source is verified by its hash.

Code128 encoded widths, ten-module quiet zones, crisp edges and exact black/white polarity are scanner constraints. Barcode value, module width and height determine SVG geometry. Do not recolor bars with screen theme tokens.

Official symbol path geometry and uploaded logos are retained. CurrentColor, container type and sizing follow central palette/utility bridges. Product Q-mark files are generated by the app-icons pipeline; images must not be reconstructed as text.

A flexible signature cell and alphanumeric UDI wrapping are selected by data attributes/classes; their actual CSS is central. A4 and 100x60mm label dimensions, page breaks, table lines, light ink and hidden controls remain central and print-tested.
Generated self-hosted font slices and licensed WOFF2 files are asset definitions, not independent screen styling. Font family selection is central.
PWA identity and generated icon coordinate data have separate asset hash/version contracts. They are not exemptions for authored app CSS.

Body scroll locking and restoration, inert/aria-hidden state, focus ownership and previous inline overflow restoration are modal interaction behavior. Overlay dimensions, colors and motion remain central CSS.

printContract.label: 100mm 60mm; 2.5mm 3mm content padding
printContract.rules: Preserve light paper palette, break-inside avoidance, final-page suppression, barcode polarity, no background ribbon/watermark/interactive controls. Shared screen tokens do not recolor barcode bars.

negativeFindings: No additional CSS modules, SCSS, standalone HTML app surface or canvas rendering was found in the initial 230-file app/components/lib/public source audit. Generated icon/font/CSS assets are covered by their explicit pipelines. This statement is dated 2026-10-10 and is supplemented by the generated complete style-arguments file inventory.

numericMeasurementBoundary.rule: CSS lengths and times are resolved through ordinary computed properties before JavaScript arithmetic. Hidden zero-size probes are measurement plumbing, removed in finally. rem/em/calc and reduced motion are verified in Edge; fixed invisible probe styles are not product appearance defaults.
